buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added Specific Conditions for Repair of CCTV, SMPS, Printers and EPBX Systems Buyer Added Specific Conditions 1. Scope of Work: The bidder shall undertake comprehensive inspection, fault diagnosis, repair, repla cement (where required), testing, commissioning, and restoration of CCTV Systems, SMPS Units, Pri nters, and EPBX Systems installed at ECHS Polyclinic Jodhpur,. The quoted rates shall include all lab our, tools, consumables, transportation, loading/unloading, and incidental expenses. 2. Site Visit: Bidders are advised to visit the respective ECHS Polyclinics before submitting the bid to assess the condition of equipment and the scope of repairs. No additional payment on account of lac k of site inspection or incorrect assessment shall be entertained after award of the contract. 3. Quality of Spares: Only new, genuine, OEM-recommended or equivalent ISI/BIS-certified spare par ts shall be used. Repaired or refurbished spare parts shall not be installed unless specifically approv

ed in writing by the Buyer. All replaced defective parts shall be handed over to the Officer-in-Charge (OIC) of the Polyclinic. 4. Warranty and Service Support: All repairs and replaced components shall carry a minimum wa rranty of six (06) months from the date of successful completion and acceptance. During the war ranty period, any recurring defect shall be rectified free of cost, including replacement of defective parts and transportation. 5. .
